question: Explain the features of a perfectly competitive market.

points.label: Many buyers and sellers
points.description: There is a large number of buyers and sellers, so an individual firm is a price taker.

points.label: Homogeneous product
points.description: All firms sell an identical (homogeneous) product.

points.label: Free entry and exit
points.description: Firms can freely enter or leave the industry.

points.label: Perfect knowledge
points.description: Buyers and sellers have perfect knowledge of market conditions and prices.

points.label: Mobility and single price
points.description: Factors of production are perfectly mobile and there are no transport costs, so a single uniform price prevails; the firm's demand curve is perfectly elastic.
